qualification: Focused current bound class-source text search; matches are not acquisition proof. Existing action/reorder/extension grants are not full turns. This is not a repository-wide nonexistence claim and does not reopen PF182.

matches.exactText: All sources share a maximum of one additional full Action per creature per round. Additional Actions cannot grant additional Actions, Bonus Actions or Reactions. Mage summons and companions do not receive independent damaging turns: all Mage-controlled conjured companions share one Companion Command per Mage regular turn. Spend one Bonus Action to command exactly one companion to move up to its Speed and use one damaging or control action from its stat block. Uncommanded companions may move to remain near you and take Dodge but cannot deal damage or impose control.

Elemental Mastery. Tags: arcanist, focus. Improve the secondary effect of your current Focus. Fire Burns from your Focus cards last one additional turn but never stack. Cold Focus Speed reductions increase by another 5 feet, minimum 0. Lightning Focus's once-per-turn secondary arc increases from S flat lightning damage to S d4 lightning damage. Pivoted Focus uses the corresponding upgraded rider.

Only one concentration effect may be maintained at a time. Starting another concentration effect ends the previous one. Damage uses the current Core Systems concentration rule; any required half-damage rounding is down for this pilot. Round recharge ticks once at the start of the Monk's regular initiative turn, including while incapacitated; extra Actions and extra turns never create additional ticks.

All sources share a maximum of one additional full Action per creature per round. Additional Actions cannot grant another additional Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. A named ability can receive at most one positive-counter recharge reset or shortening per round. Only an ability whose current recharge counter is above 0 can be reset or shortened.

Martial Apex. Tags: arch, capstone, action. When at exactly 5 Ki, spend all 5 as you begin a Monk technique that normally requires an Action. That technique does not consume your normal Action but counts as the one additional full Action allowed to you that round. Add one additional copy of its base rolled damage dice to one damage roll. It cannot be used on healing-only techniques or a Hero Final. Spending all 5 Ki replaces only that technique's printed Ki cost; any RP, rest-use, target and recharge requirements are still paid/met. The bonus dice apply to one target only, cannot copy critical bonus dice, and cannot generate further attacks or resources.

Mind Cloud. Tags: hero, shadow, psychic, control, weave. The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it loses its Reaction and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. It repeats the save at the end of that turn; on failure the effect lasts one additional round, then ends automatically. The effect never forces the target to attack allies or surrender control of its full turn.

ADDITIONAL ACTION GUARD. All sources share a maximum of one additional full Action per creature per round. An additional Action cannot grant another additional Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. Features that say a creature acts out of turn use this same cap. Movement-only grants do not count as additional full Actions.

resistance to explicitly time/aging damage and advantage on saves against aging/slow effects; once per encounter spend 1 RC after another creature finishes its turn to take one additional full Action immediately, subject to the global action cap.
once per encounter gain one additional full Action on your turn, subject to the common cap. Also, once per round when an attack hits you, roll d10; on 1 it instead strikes a temporal echo and misses.

1/long rest gain one additional full Action during your turn, subject to the universal one-extra-Action cap. The additional Action may only activate a Revelation or be used to Dash/Move as an Action and cannot generate another Action.

For 2 rounds, once on each of your regular turns you gain one additional full Action usable only to activate a Revelation or Dash/Move, subject to the universal extra-Action cap. Allies within 5 tiles gain +1 on attack rolls, reduce the first damage they take each round by S and are immune to Frightened. Once per round you may activate one known Tier I Ancestor Revelation for 0 RC; it still uses its normal action type. When Convergence ends you are suffering Revelation backlash until the end of your next turn: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and Speed -5 feet. Concentration is required. At most three chosen allies gain its aura. The free Tier I activation uses its ordinary action type and shares the two-Revelation ceiling.

Choose one willing ally. It may immediately use its Reaction to either move up to its Speed, make one ordinary weapon attack, or activate one class feature that normally uses an Action or Bonus Action. This counts as that creature's one possible additional full Action for the round where applicable. If it deals damage with the granted action, add S damage to one damage roll. It reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1. Before the command resolves, a second ally within range may move 1 tile without provoking opportunity attacks. The ally pays every ordinary resource cost, rest use and recharge and meets every prerequisite. This is one additional Action for the shared cap; it cannot activate an action-granting feature.

For 2 rounds, each ally in range may once on its regular turn gain one additional full Action usable only for one ordinary weapon attack or Dash/Move, subject to the universal extra-Action cap. Allies also gain +1 on attack rolls and reduce the first damage they take each round by 1. You gain +2 AC and immunity to Frightened. Once per round you may activate one known Tier I Battle Revelation for 0 RC using its normal action type. The first qualifying ally each round to reduce a meaningful enemy to 0 HP regains 1d6 HP. When the effect ends, you are suffering Revelation backlash until the end of your next turn: -1 on attacks and saves and Speed -5 feet. Concentration is required; choose at most three allies for its benefits. Each granted Action may make only one ordinary weapon attack or Dash, and cannot grant another action.

Manifest three banners for 3 rounds. Offense Banner: once on each of your turns add 2 S damage to one weapon or Revelation damage roll. Defense Banner: gain +2 AC; allies within 5 tiles reduce first damage each round by 1. Rally Banner: once per round one ally within 5 tiles gains +1 on an attack roll made during its turn. Your known Tier I Battle Revelations cost 0 RC while all three banners remain. You may sacrifice one banner as a Reaction to leave an ally within 5 tiles at 1 HP instead of 0, or as a Bonus Action to restore your RC to maximum; that banner's benefit ends immediately. When the 3-round effect ends naturally, regain 2 RC, never above maximum. The Final grants no more than one additional full Action per creature per round.

Each target may immediately move up to 2 tiles without provoking opportunity attacks and gains concealment until it attacks, deals damage, forces a saving throw or the duration ends. The first damaging attack each target lands while concealed by Shared Dream adds S psychic damage once. This movement is not an additional full Action.

Choose one willing ally. It immediately chooses one: move up to 2 tiles without provoking opportunity attacks, or activate one known Tier I Revelation or equivalent Tier-I Oracle Revelation it possesses using its Reaction and paying its normal RC cost. Any granted Revelation activation counts against that creature's one possible additional full Action for the round. You and that ally gain +2 to initiative ordering until the end of the next round.

For 2 rounds, once per round when an ally within 5 tiles fails an attack roll, saving throw or ability check, use your Reaction to let that ally reroll and use the new result; this changes only the roll and does not refund resources, Actions, damage or proc triggers from events already resolved. Once on each of your regular turns you gain one additional full Action usable only to activate a Revelation or Dash/Move, subject to the universal extra-Action cap. An ally whose roll you rewind reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1. If an enemy directly benefited from the original failed roll, it makes a Wisdom save; on failure it loses its Reaction until the end of its next turn. After Convergence ends you are suffering Revelation backlash until end of your next turn: -1 attacks/saves and Speed -5 feet.

Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Echo Strike: its copied damage equals the triggering attack's full unmodified rolled damage dice total instead of half; it still copies no modifiers, conditions, resources or proc triggers. Enhanced Rewind Wound: may target yourself. Enhanced Spiral Convergence: its additional full Action may use any normal Action type except one that grants another Action; the universal one-extra-Action cap remains.

For 3 rounds, at the start of each of your regular turns choose ONE temporal option, each usable at most once during this Final. ECHO REVELATION: repeat only the immediate numeric damage, healing, movement or buff component of one beneficial Time Revelation you personally resolved during the previous round, paying 0 RC; this copy is not a new Revelation cast, copies no resource restoration, action grant, hard control, condition trigger, Prophecy Trigger or proc. FORCED ECHO: choose one non-player enemy within 5 tiles and one ordinary weapon attack or non-resource movement action it took during its previous turn. The enemy makes a Wisdom save. On failure, during its next turn it must repeat that action pattern if legally possible, but it chooses all legal targets and paths; it spends no limited resources and cannot be forced to harm itself. A player-controlled creature instead, on a failed save, loses its Reaction and must choose either repeat one ordinary non-resource action type from its prior turn or have Speed reduced to 0 until turn end. Allies retain memory of all temporal echoes. This Final never creates more than one additional full Action for any creature in a round. There are only two options in this Final; after using both once, remaining rounds provide only the printed temporal presence, without another echo. An echoed healing amount also pays 1 RC or consumes an unused per-rest healing use; a temporal copy cannot create an uncosted healing reserve.

All sources share a maximum of one additional full Action per creature per round. Additional Actions cannot grant another additional Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. Spell copies, Matrix Sharing, Arcane Fusion, Dual Cast and similar effects pay all explicitly required RP and do not produce duplicate resource, cast-proc or action-grant chains beyond their written resolution.

Round recharge counters decrease once at the start of your regular initiative turn even if you cannot act. Extra Actions and extra turns do not tick recharge. Outside initiative, each uninterrupted 6 seconds counts as one tick. Only positive counters can be reset or shortened and each named ability can receive at most one reset or shortening per round.

Arcane Domination. Tags: hero, necromancer, wizard-spell, enchantment, control, concentration. Target WIS save; failure Charmed for 1 minute, repeat at end each turn and on damage. Once during this effect, spend Bonus Action to command its NEXT normal turn: Move up to Speed and either Dodge, Disengage or make one ordinary weapon attack, replacing its normal Action and using the shared hard-denial mark. It gains no extra turn or attack; later turns retain normal actions while Charmed, with no Reactions until effect ends. A PC chooses its legal attack target and reasonable route. No self-harm, forced spell/resource expenditure, belief change or permanent control.

Source progression line 5188. Choose two DIFFERENT prepared Wizard spells of rank 1 or 2, neither of which summons a creature or grants an additional Action. Cast both sequentially as one Action, paying both RP costs. They cannot both require concentration. Each matrix separately updates first-cast/Refrain history. Features that trigger merely from 'casting a spell' may trigger once for each actual matrix unless that feature itself says once per turn; no trigger may create another Dual Cast or additional full Action.

Round recharge counters are set after resolution and decrease once at the start of the Cleric's regular initiative turn, even if the Cleric cannot act. Extra Actions and extra turns do not create extra recharge ticks. Outside initiative, each uninterrupted 6 seconds counts as one recharge tick. Only a positive counter may be reset or shortened, and a named ability can receive at most one reset or shortening per round.
Totems last 1 extra turn. Renewal may have a fourth pulse only if you pay Bonus Action+1 RP on that turn; no fifth pulse and no automatic free healing. Concentration still required.
